'''Mudkip''' (Japanese: '''ミズゴロウ''' ''Mizugorou'') is a Pokémon that [[Ginji]] befriends in [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Ginji's Rescue Team]].

== Character ==
Initially, Mudkip is a cowardly Pokémon that longs to become stronger and form a rescue team. He idolizes {{p|Alakazam}} of [[Team A.C.T.]].

== History ==
After meeting Ginji and seeing his determination, they team up to form a rescue team. He accompanies Ginji on his adventures and remains extremely loyal to him.

Throughout the story, Mudkip becomes braver and stronger. One example is when he befriends [[Team Meanies|Gengar]] despite the fact that Gengar had mistreated them before.

At the end of the story, when Ginji becomes a human again, it is revealed that Mudkip continues rescuing Pokémon.
